title: The Ambassador's Works, the Wheel, and the Three Zones
description: T35 describes four works of the Lord's call going out to the rational: the image shown forth in glory, the gates between discrete degrees opened and shut, the chosen-out light and discriminating sight given to the soul, and the Lord manifesting in the perfection of those fully come into him — laying down a hidden chamber even where self-love had ruled. T36 expounds the recurring process of discrimination set before the gate where the Lord rules over the discrete degrees — every motion of the proprium in any firmament made known there as in a great mirror, none able to release itself from the bonds. T37 describes how the natural mind is built as nested circuits: the proprium in five aspects fettered inside the rational's five degrees as it goes forth from the Divine Human, with the rational's five degrees of upward operation around them, all under the firmament.
